casual.scene: Cool rain light spills beneath the covered wooden porch; she wipes a small Lechonk companion dry with a soft towel, beside a resting umbrella and wet clay pots.
casual.outfit: A cropped lemon linen shirt tied at the waist and tailored mini-length trouser shorts expose her midriff and legs; simple flat sandals suit the wet porch.

prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Lechonk (맛보돈) personified, normal type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her species shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never armor, never a creature costume. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the whole scene for this frame; Framing below sets how much of her shows.

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its armor, garment, layers, sash, tassels, jewelry, hair ornaments or background. Dress her exactly as the scene settings below describe; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her source belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her own costume, genre or palette.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera as the scene settings below describe, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same.

SCENE (chosen):
Expression: soft distant gaze past the camera, faint wistful half-smile, brows gently raised at the inner ends
Pose: Gently lower one hand to pat the scene's Pokémon companion with a natural shoulder and elbow angle.
Orientation: side body profile, approximately 90 degrees to camera
Scene: Cool rain light spills beneath the covered wooden porch; she wipes a small Lechonk companion dry with a soft towel, beside a resting umbrella and wet clay pots.
Outfit and props: A cropped lemon linen shirt tied at the waist and tailored mini-length trouser shorts expose her midriff and legs; simple flat sandals suit the wet porch.
Category: Show a quiet personal moment caring for a Pokémon companion. Make the interaction, supporting props and comfortable setting specific; keep the approved woman as the main subject and any companion anatomically separate.
Example scene: Wiping rain from a Pokémon companion with a towel under a covered porch, umbrellas resting nearby.
Framing: Full-body framing: keep the complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: balanced — a readable moment of gentle movement, not a ratio of multiple images
source_influence: balanced — her species shows as one accessory and one object in the scene; the outfit keeps its own colours and patterns
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

ONE WOMAN ONLY, with exactly one Pokémon companion as the scene describes — a separate creature at its own natural scale, its body never merged with hers, not a second human and not dressed like her. No other person or creature, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame.

HANDS: natural human hands.

HAND TASK: her hands act naturally for the pose and scene; any idle hand rests in a relaxed, anatomically plausible position. Natural occlusion is allowed; do not force every hand or finger into view.
capture_method: Actual local prompt.html controls in Chromium; planner query locks for casual.
